points.description: States that a rating curve is valid only when there is no overflow/flood (flow stays within the channel banks, no out-of-bank flow) in the region/river.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if on the right track but vague, e.g. mentions only stable/normal flow conditions or a flood-related idea without clearly saying no overflow.

rubric.notes: Full marks for the idea that the rating curve holds only when there is no overflow or flood, in any wording (e.g. flow within banks, no flooding). Give 1 mark for a vague or partial answer such as stable or normal flow conditions, or a flood-related remark that is not clearly stated. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong answers, such as saying it is valid during floods.
